assertions.description: window.launchQueue exists: the queue that focus-existing launches deliver LaunchParams into.
LaunchQueue.prototype.setConsumer is a function (the consumer that now runs with activation).
LaunchParams exposes targetURL, which a focus-existing consumer reads to decide whether to open a separate window.
navigator.userActivation exposes isActive, so a consumer can observe the activation granted at delivery.
When an installed app with launch_handler client_mode "focus-existing" is launched while a window is open, navigator.userActivation.isActive is true inside the launchQueue consumer.
assertions.test: Requires installing the app and launching a shortcut from the OS while a window is open; observe the isActive column at /v160/webapplaunch-user-activation-on-focus-existing-launch-delivery/workspace-app/.

assertions.description: A focus-existing consumer can call window.open() for a launch targeting another workspace without it being popup-blocked.
assertions.test: Requires an installed app and a real OS launch; the workspace app's consumer records the window.open() result per launch.

assertions.description: The activation granted at delivery is ordinary transient activation: the first activation-consuming call (window.open, requestFullscreen) consumes it.
assertions.test: Requires a real launch; the same consumption rule is demonstrated with a click at /v160/webapplaunch-user-activation-on-focus-existing-launch-delivery/activation-gated-apis/.
